title: Tue 24 Nov · evening check
summary:
[b]Today:[/b] BoE Greene said the Bank is 'a little bit behind the curve' and backed further hikes (pound strength condition met; ~80% priced for 17 Dec); Ifo 90.6 in line; US consumer confidence 103.3 vs ~92 expected; Macklem renewed the inflation framework with no rate hint; tech sell-off lifted the VIX back near 28; oil near three-month lows. No published score changes; GBP crosses under watch (scenario GBP +3).
[b]Next:[/b] Wed 25 Nov Australia October CPI 02:30, US Q3 GDP + October PCE 15:30, BoE Treasury Committee 16:15; Thu 26 Nov US Thanksgiving, French CMP (date not confirmed).

USD.note: Conference Board confidence 103.3 vs ~92.2 expected (MEDIUM); December hike ~95%; no Fed speaker before the meeting.

EUR.note: Ifo 90.6 in line (MEDIUM); OAT–Bund 153.1bp on 23 Nov from 155.4bp; no CMP step.

GBP.note: Greene: BoE 'a little bit behind the curve', further tightening appropriate (strength condition met); shadow 0 central, +3 if R2 +1.

JPY.note: Carried: risk-on condition met on Monday close; partly reversed today (VIX ~28); no MoF comment; shadow unchanged.

CHF.note: VIX back near 28 intraday: franc-weakening line (VIX under 25) moved away; no SNB item.

CAD.note: Macklem renewed the 2% framework and CPIX, gave no rate guidance (strength condition not met); WTI ~$79–81.

AUD.note: Carried from Monday risk-on close, fading today; CPI 02:30 Bucharest (one source: 4.8% y/y forecast).

NZD.note: Carried: Q3 retail beat and Monday risk-on; NZDUSD ~0.5446, lowest since 2009 (price only).

XAU.note: Gold −2.3% to ~$3,566 is price context only; no ETF, central-bank or real-yield data; G +1.
